nodes.text: Elias passed away last night. You worked for him for years. In his will, he left you the Kestrel.
The ship is yours. Go make a life of your own.
You have 100 credits. This is the Erebus System. Fly to Meridian and meet Rook at the bar. He has work.
Keep her flying. Rook will be waiting.

lines.text: Ah, you must be the pilot Rook sent. He mentioned you might stop by. Says you’re reliable enough. That’s usually all I need to hear.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Not exactly. They’re sightings, not a live tracking beacon. But give someone enough sightings and they can start making educated guesses.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: It’s a hobby. People fly around scanning electronic signals. Ships, stations, satellites, navigation beacons. Anything broadcasting something interesting.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Things have been getting a little interesting out there lately. The Communion and the Natural Order are at each other’s throats again.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Naturally.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Every time someone scans your ship, they might record your electronic signature, where you were, and when you were there.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Got a minute? I’ve got something for Rook. Small crate. Sealed.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Rook said you might make the trip. Welcome to The Darknet District. Your ship is fine on the landing pad; The Function charges for parking, not for staying.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Iris has the contracts. I just make the introductions.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Suit yourself. It’ll keep.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: You’ve got a delivery to make. Come back when it’s done.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Won’t make you invisible. Won’t stop a police officer from looking through your cockpit window. But it can make life considerably more frustrating for anyone trying to piece together your travel history.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Something Rook paid for, and something you don’t need to know about. It stays sealed.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Been arguing about it for generations. Occasionally they shoot at each other. Usually somewhere inconvenient for the rest of us.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Rook’s expecting it. Don’t open it.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: After that last delivery? I’d say you got lucky.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: So, you made it back. Good. Rook said everything arrived.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: So, what do you think? Which direction you feel like heading?
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Always got work. Just depends on where you’re willing to go.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: WarFlying scramblers. They interfere with the electronic signatures those scanners use to identify ships.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Well, nothing that’s supposed to be exciting.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: That’s because you’re thinking about the people collecting points.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Communion’s big on artificial intelligence. Practically worship the stuff. Natural Order? They’d rather smash a computer than let one make a decision for them.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: One utility slot, though. You’ll have to decide which matters more.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Finish the job you’re carrying first. Then we’ll talk.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Anyway, I’ve got two deliveries that need moving. One’s headed into Communion territory, the other’s going to a Natural Order outpost. Both pay decent.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Of course, there are ways to make your ship harder to identify.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: One sighting doesn’t tell much of a story. A hundred sightings? Suddenly someone knows where you travel, which stations you visit, and how often you make a particular run.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Eh. Trouble’s good for business. Long as it stays somewhere else.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Every new signal they discover earns them a point. There’s even a leaderboard. People get surprisingly competitive about it.

lines.text: Advanced electronics. Research equipment, mostly. They’re always building something over there. Pays well enough.

lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Progress is not the enemy of humanity.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: A diagnosis that comes an hour earlier is an hour given back to a family.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Across The Nexus, families continue to endure the consequences of an attack against the systems that once supported their daily lives.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: We will share what we learn.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Restoration is not merely a technological objective. It is a humanitarian responsibility.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: The Communion remains committed to rebuilding what was lost.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Should I be? They’ve been threatening us since before I was born. Eventually you learn to get on with your day.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Actually, since you’re here, there may be something else you could help us with.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Excellent. We’ve been waiting for these components.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: You must be our delivery. From The Darknet District?
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: They think we’re giving machines too much control. We think they’re afraid of anything they don’t understand. Truth’s probably more complicated.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Everything looks to be in order. Thank you.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Back again? I was hoping we’d see you.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Good. We’ve been waiting on this shipment. Things have been a little unpredictable lately.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Funny. Most of us are just trying to keep civilization running.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Anyway, that’s above my pay grade. Let’s get this unloaded.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Hard to say. They’ve been moving ships around near the border. Probably just trying to make a point.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: We do. There’s quite a bit of work underway, and the situation with the Natural Order isn’t making things any easier.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Nothing new, really. The Natural Order’s been making noise again. They don’t much care for the way we do things here.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Appreciate the delivery. Tell Admin everything arrived intact.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: A delivery on our homeworld. Something that would help our people. I’d rather explain the details once you’re there.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Among other things. They seem convinced we’re building something that’s going to destroy civilization.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: The ship is yours. Go make a life of your own.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Rusthaven stays alive because people keep bringing what we need.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: I run security here. Talk to Admin first; he likes to meet new pilots himself.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Some of it is actually rather interesting.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Occupied. I’m handling things for now. Don’t worry, he left instructions to pay you.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: You’re already carrying someone else’s cargo. Come back when your hold is free.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: So I see. Both shipments delivered, both clients satisfied. Remarkable, considering they can barely tolerate each other’s existence.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Essentially. Although these shipments are a little more specialized.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Of course. I’ll keep the contract available. For now.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Let’s see... cargo received, delivery confirmed, and no complaints from the recipient. How refreshingly uneventful.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: At least, not by my standards.
lines.provenance: Voice manifest literal; may be conditional or retained for archived playback. Source references show current code.

lines.text: Oh, before you go. Admin had another shipment lined up. The one you didn’t take.

lines.text: We keep our own records here. Get settled, meet the locals, and keep your eyes open.

You're staring. I don't mind.

On my way.
You called?

Stay like this a little while.
Come here.
Oh. I've been wanting that.

Not yet. I'm still getting brave.
Sit with me first? Or we could dance.

This is my favourite kind of quiet.
Goodnight. Come back soon?

Hi. Can I stand with you a while?

The city looks softer from up here.
Can I sit with you?
Is there room for me?
Will you sit with me a while?
Come sit. I don't want to be on my own.

Coming.

Don't let go yet.
Come here.

Slow down. Trust takes a minute.
Not yet. Talk to me first.

Hey. Talk to me.

Don't let go, okay?
Come here.
Wow. Okay. Again sometime?
Ha. That was nice.
Whoa, slow down, speedy. Talk to me first.
Not yet! Let's hang out a bit.
Sit with me first, or dance with me! Then we'll see.

This is nice. Even I can enjoy doing nothing.
Bye! Come back soon, or I'll come find you.

Hey! Over here!
You're too far away. Come closer.
There you are. I was getting restless.

I could stare at this city all night. Well, for a bit.
Scoot over!
Room for me? Great.
Sit with me? I promise not to fidget. Much.
Come sit, I want to hear everything.
Dance with me! Come on, it's good for you.
This song! We have to dance.
Lie back with me a minute? I'll actually stay still.
Yes!
Knew you'd say yes.
Aw. Okay, next time.

You've got a great smile.
I like hanging out with you.

Coming!
Right here!

Follow my lead. Feel the beat first.

See? You were made for this.

Closer. Mind the paint.

Slow down. Every good song has a build-up.
Sit with me first, or ask me for a dance.

You came back. The room just got brighter.
You're easy to dance for.
I like it when you watch me move.
Dancing over.
See? I glow even lying down.
Hey. Glad you made it up here.
There you are. Grab a seat, or don't, I'm easy.

I like this place. Nobody needs anything from me up here.

Careful. I'm easily charmed.
Oh yeah? Go on, I'm listening.
You've got a way about you, you know that?
Sit down, take a load off.
There. Much better.
I've got two left feet, but let's go.
Just sway. Nobody's judging.
Hey, look at us. Not bad.
Steady grip. I like that.
Don't rush off.
Come here.

Hm. I could get used to that.
Easy. Let's talk a bit first.
No rush. We've got all night.
Sit down first, or ask me for a dance. Then we'll talk.
Close your eyes. I'll keep watch.
Can't beat this. Honestly.
Night. Mind the stairs.
Take care out there. Come back soon.
Hey. Figured you could use a friendly face.
Come on over, I don't bite.
There you are.
See those cranes? I worked on the third one from the left.

Mind if I sit?
Shove over a bit?
Sit with me a while?

Coming.
Right here.
